notes.title: I hear things as time passes!
notes.content:
In this version, the focus was to bring more agility to the development of civilization in addition to a more interactive experience with new sprites and sounds

New item:

 Donut - made in the bakery


New constructions:

 Seeding - responsible for turning grass into seeds
 Research and Development Center - responsible for research that will expedite the development of civilization


New sprites:

 Person over 60 years old - sprite to define how much a person is over 60 years old
 Buildings get old - over time buildings that have grasses get old


New sounds:

 Ambient sound - inclusion of ambient sound for day and night
 Sound effects - inclusion of sound effects in people's actions, research findings and routine change


New screen:

 Survey - inclusion of survey panel


Hope you like this update

Tiago Portella - Creator

notes.title: Meu Mundo 2.0
notes.content:
After almost 2 years of work and planning, we released version 2.0 of Meu Mundo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35398864/5ee4b15e10e384607ef1d8037a15f8e5d1c9b8e4.png
The essence of the game has not changed, but with this new version we have started a new world with infinite possibilities.

News:


 Map with procedural generation, that is, we have infinite maps now my friends.
 Genetic control of entities, now there are genetic traits that are visible or not.
 Sprites redone and engaged in the game profile
 Functional constructions adapted to the current style of the game
 Redone interface with more game control and more information
 Life cycle of entities, including from birth, reproduction and death
 Frequent updates


I know that a long time has passed without an update, because of the change so great that we have prepared for you.

I hope you enjoy and have fun.

Att,

Tiago Portella

notes.title: Update 1.0.28
notes.content:
Updates: 

Created item store to purchase new in-game items
 Layers function created in inhabitants allowing new colors
 Inclusion of skin colors: White, Brunette and Black
 Hair Color Inclusion: Light Brown, Dark Brown, Blonde, Black and Red
 Inclusion of dress colors: Blue, White and Red
 Including trouser colors: Blue, Black and Green
 Including shirt colors: Beige, White and Gray


 Corrections: 

 Fixed the animation flow of the inhabitants when they walk.
 Improved movement of inhabitants
 Improved choice of tasks for inhabitants
 Removed ghosts from code

notes.title: New discoveries!?
notes.content:
Updates:

 Research Center created, enabling new tool and item discoveries
 Craftsman created allowing new items to be manufactured
 Inclusion of more item stores, allowing definition of items to be stored
 Flower sprite change, the earth now doesn't occupy the whole square
 Adding Steam Achievements
 Allowed to include new trees, when placing the tree there is a one in a thousand chance of being a peach tree, one in a hundred of being an apple tree and one in ten of being an orange tree
 Allowed to set decorative trees that will not be cut
 Demolition tool removal of trees allowed
 Bridge created, allowing inhabitants to cross from initial island to mainland
 Skills for the inhabitants, allowing the evolution of the inhabitants in the defined services.


 Corrections: 

 Fixed flow in which residents seek food in homes
 Fixed overall game performance
 Removed ghost from code

notes.title: Versão 1.0.26
notes.content:
Atualizações:

 Criada função que permite que mais de um habitante possa trabalhar na mesma construção, na utilização da enxada são até 4 habitantes e no martelo são até 8 habitantes
 Melhorada a forma de carregar os itens, agora mais de um habitante carrega os itens para a mesma construção ou edificação
 Implementada a função para ocultar as paredes e teto das casas, apenas apertar em "V" vai permitir enxergar oque está atrás das casas

Correções:

 Corrigido o objetivo "Colheita Feliz" que necessitava de 10 casas e 1 horta, agora precisa apenas de 10 casas para concluir o objetivo
 Produção de alimentos foi corrigida para evitar que os alimentos fiquem espalhados pelo mapa
